title: Scalar cycle realization for a fixed connective perfect direct-image model
statement: Choose shared derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→S be flat proper locally of finite presentation, L invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], k:W→S any map, w in W, and U an affine open neighbourhood of w. Put A=Gamma(W,U). Suppose a fixed strictly perfect K on the localized site over U has zero terms in negative degrees [def-pc-perfect-complex], section bases e0:Gamma(K^0)≅A and e1:Gamma(K^1)≅A^m, and a derived isomorphism hE identifying K with the restriction of R(f_W)_*(L_W[0]) [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Suppose d in A^m satisfies e1(d_K^0(e0 inverse(a)))=a d for every a and each d coordinate evaluates to zero at w [def-weil-residue-field]. There exists an additive equivalence c between global sections of L on the residue fibre Y=X times_S Spec kappa(w) and kappa(w). For every smaller open V containing w there exist j:Y→X_V hitting all points above w and e:j^*L_V≅L_Y [def-pc-base-change,def-pc-module-pullback]. Every a in Gamma(W,V) with a times the restricted vector d equal to zero is realized by a section sigma of L_V whose canonical adjunction-unit restriction along j, followed by e, equals c inverse of a(w) [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. This concerns a fixed source model; it has no target family, degree-one comparison map, or H-one injectivity assumption.

source.place: Tag 0BF2, degree-zero cycle lifting, with Tag 0B91 and the degree-zero canonical mate of Tag 08HY; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BF2

proof.text: Use the affine equivalence between quasi-coherent modules on U and modules over A=Gamma(W,U). Each strictly perfect term is a retract of a finite free sheaf, hence quasi-coherent. The supplied global-section bases e0,e1 therefore give sheaf bases of K-zero and K-one. The equality hd identifies the outgoing differential with a times d. On any V contained in U, a scalar annihilating the restricted d defines a cycle in degree zero. There are no incoming boundaries because all negative terms are zero.

Apply hE and the canonical arbitrary base-change isomorphism for the relatively flat invertible module L, first to V and then to Spec kappa(w). In degree zero, derived direct image is ordinary pushforward. Thus the cycle on V determines sigma. At the residue point hdw makes the differential zero and the scalar degree-zero basis identifies the cycle group with kappa(w). Its comparison with fibre sections gives c. The same fixed hE and basis e0 define these comparisons on every smaller open.

Factor the residue-field point of W through V, and apply the fibre-product universal property to construct j from Y to X_V. Its image is exactly the points above w: for x above w, the canonical map Spec kappa(x) to X_V factors through its fibre over Spec kappa(w), so the corresponding point of Y maps to x. Tensor-pullback composition, together with equality of the two composites to X, gives e. The canonical degree-zero mate square computes restriction along j as the adjunction unit. Naturality of the derived comparison sends the scalar cycle to its evaluation a(w), hence e transports restriction of sigma to c inverse of a(w). The restriction from j inverse of top to top is the presheaf identity after the canonical equality, giving the exact displayed expression. No assertion that d vanishes on a neighbourhood, nor any scalar lifting assertion, is used.

theorem picard_scalar_model_cycles_realization
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) (w : W)
    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (m : ℕ) (d : Fin m → Γ(W, U))
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K) (hneg : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (K.X i))
    (e0 : (K.X 0).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] Γ(W, U))
    (e1 : (K.X 1).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] (Fin m → Γ(W, U)))
    (hE : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))
    (hd : ∀ a : Γ(W, U), e1 ((K.d 0 1).val.app (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (e0.symm a)) = a • d)
    (hdw : ∀ i, W.evaluation U w hwU (d i) = 0) :
      ∃ c : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback
          (pullback.fst f (W.fromSpecResidueField w ≫ k))).obj L, ⊤) ≃+
            W.residueField w,
        ∀ (V : W.Opens) (hwV : w ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U),
          ∃ j : pullback f (W.fromSpecResidueField w ≫ k) ⟶ pullback f (V.ι ≫ k),
            (∀ x : (pullback f (V.ι ≫ k) : Scheme.{v}),
              (pullback.snd f (V.ι ≫ k)) x = (⟨w, hwV⟩ : V.toScheme) →
                ∃ y, j y = x) ∧
            ∃ e : (Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
                ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L) ≅
                (Modules.tensorPullback
                  (pullback.fst f (W.fromSpecResidueField w ≫ k))).obj L,
              ∀ a : Γ(W, V),
                (a • (fun i ↦ W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (d i)) = 0) →
                ∃ σ : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L, ⊤),
                  e.hom.app ⊤
                    (((Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
                      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L)).presheaf.map
                        (homOfLE j.preimage_top.ge).op
                          (((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
                            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L)).val.app
                              (Opposite.op ⊤) σ)) =
                    c.symm (W.evaluation V w hwV a)
